description: Workflow calling a connection-backed activity returns a CONNECTION_ACTIVITY_CALL node with a connection property

metadata.label: fetchOrder
metadata.description: Fetch order details as a workflow activity.

codedata.sourceCode: int orderData = check ctx->callActivity(fetchOrder, {connection: orderClient, id: 1});

Identity of this step within the workflow, matching a node of the descriptor

metadata.label: Approval Policy
metadata.description: Whether a person approves before this runs: no approval, or a review a reviewer proceeds with (optionally editing the arguments) or rejects

metadata.label: Reviewer Roles
metadata.description: Role(s) permitted to decide the human review, e.g. "manager" or ["finance", "manager"]. Leave empty to allow any role.

metadata.label: Reviewers
metadata.description: User id(s) permitted to decide the review, whatever their roles

metadata.label: Excluded Reviewers
metadata.description: User id(s) that may not decide the review

metadata.label: Excluded Roles
metadata.description: Role(s) that may not decide the review
